identification: Hand-painted watercolour of a steep river gorge with a road cut along the cliff, snow peak behind (NZ gorge, Buller/Otira type), signed lower right 'W. Menzies Gibb' (William Menzies Gibb, Scotland/NZ, 1859-1931). About 28x21 cm image, cream mount, dark and gilt timber frame under glass. This is the same painting as Armitage sale 28976 lot 1014 'Gorge Scene' H28 W21 (closed 11 Nov 2026, estimate 40-60): same image, frame and title, so it is being relisted two weeks after selling there.
